evidence.quote: not intelligence is capability. And more information does not solve your problem.

observations.why: Frames effective capability and actionable mastery over passive information/intelligence as the core value.

evidence.quote: It's really about the delegation of work that requires expertise to carry it out. And the person, the business owner, the consultant, the expert, is currently the bottleneck.

observations.why: Appeals to autonomy and operational scale by removing the individual expert bottleneck through codified capability delegation.
Expresses commitment to fair, transparent dealing with prospective partners without deceptive tactics.

mints.title: not intelligence is capability
